# Enforced Routines (bypass: `node tools/routines.js bypass <id> [--session]`)

- **always-worktree** (hard): Feature work: create or enter a git worktree first (superpowers:using-git-worktrees skill). Never feature-work directly on the main branch clone.
- **fix-pr-until-green** (hard): After opening a PR, not DONE until `node tools/pr-guard.js <pr-number>` passes: all CI checks green, all review threads resolved.
- **identity-query-inline** (hard): Identity/memory queries (who am I, what do you know about me, my preferences): answer INLINE via `node ~/dev/AgentSystem/tools/graph/graph-query.js personal-brain <keywords> --brain-path=~/agent-memory/nexus/personal-brain --record-access`. Never spawn an agent — ~110 tokens vs 47k.
- **memory-write-back** (hard): Learned a durable fact (user preference, decision, correction, stable project/company context, reusable pattern)? Persist immediately, do not wait for session end: `node ~/dev/AgentSystem/tools/brain-remember.js --fact=\"<fact>\" [--tier=repo --target=<slug> | --tier=agent --target=<name>]`. Tiers: personal (default) = about the user; repo:<slug> = technical/business fact about ONE repo (slugs in ~/agent-memory/nexus/known-repos.json; match what the repo IS, e.g. genie=product UI vs genie-brain=Arbor Genie backend); agent:<name> = pattern about one agent. Durable + specific only; skip one-off details and speculation. Dedup automatic. Stop-hook memory-capture.js sweeps as backup.
- **post-merge-cleanup** (hard): After `gh pr merge`: confirm the linked issue is closed (`gh issue close <N>` with a comment referencing the PR) and the source branch is deleted (`--delete-branch`, or `gh api` if missed). Leave no merged branches or linked-but-open issues.
- **verify-before-close** (hard): Before closing any GitHub issue, verify the fix landed: `node ~/dev/AgentSystem/tools/issue-close.js <n> --commit <sha>` (checks the commit is reachable from origin/main via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, then closes with a reference comment). Never bare `gh issue close` for fix-type issues — closed-without-landed-commit caused a full re-audit (#151).
